name: Destitute Widow Pension
summary: A monthly pension for destitute widows with little or no property.
benefit_note: ₹1,200 a month, credited directly to a bank account.
how_to_apply: Apply at your Village Administrative Officer, Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body office.
Once approved, the pension is credited to your bank account each month.

TRANSLATION WARNING. Amounts and the property limit come from the TAMIL version of the Commissionerate of Revenue Administration page (cra.tn.gov.in/about_schemes_t.php), read through automatic translation on 2026-08-09. A Tamil reader must confirm, particularly the ₹1,00,000 property figure.

DISTINCT FROM THE CENTRAL WIDOW PENSION. The Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme starts at age 40 and requires below poverty line status; this state scheme starts at 18 and uses a property test instead. Both exist in Tamil Nadu. IGNWPS is not yet in the corpus and should be added separately rather than merged into this file.

ALSO DISTINCT FROM the Dr. Dharmambal widow REMARRIAGE assistance already in the corpus. That is a one-off payment on remarrying; this is an ongoing pension. A widow could qualify for both at different times.
